title: Creating an RPG with AI
author: Samariuml
selftext:
Hello everyone,

I see this forum on generative AI and I would like to have your opinion. I am creating an app that allows to generate games with AI.

For example, I can generate maps with overlays/collisions with a gameplay.

However, I don't yet have character generation (graphics).

What do you think?

https://preview.redd.it/tfyytq6qfpzd1.png?width=768&format=png&auto=webp&s=1b2976d3496057b63ba9d41c56a4e79231a38c08

comments.author: Financial-Drummer825
comments.body: Hello! I previously launched an AI game editor, and now I’m developing an AI-native game called *Echo of Mobius*, where players can generate their own characters ([https://www.echoofmobius.com/](https://www.echoofmobius.com/)). I believe this is the future of gaming.

replies.author: Financial-Drummer825
replies.body: I have about 5k users for both products. May I ask what progress you're making?

replies.author: AdamFilandr
replies.body: Nice! How did you market your products? Making videos about them, sharing online, paid advertisement? Can you share what worked the best for getting users?

replies.author: Financial-Drummer825
replies.body: I think the most useful advertisement is streaming. Due to the nature of AI games, they are particularly suit for streaming.

replies.author: Top_Effect_5109
replies.body: Your site layout gets messed up for me on my android phone.

replies.author: Financial-Drummer825
replies.body: Yeah. It's for PC since it's a PC game, but I'm working on mobile version.

comments.author: Samariuml
comments.body:
I've made a video, if you want to see the idea in action

[https://youtu.be/vw\_aMRLvzR4](https://youtu.be/vw_aMRLvzR4)

comments.author: Cool-Yellow6973
comments.body: I think the pixel style is good and even this simple map looks cute. However, as you mention there is not yet character generation, it might be an issue. Role-playing games need a lot of chats between NPCs, which is where generative AI can be a help. I recommend you take a look at this website [rpggo.ai](http://rpggo.ai), on which the AI-generated NPCs are available and the chats become a great part of the RPGs powered by AI.  Hope you do well with your development.
